name: wp-rdt-cid-extra-click-id
description: [PLUGIN BEHAVIOR] rdt_cid (Reddit) IS a captured click ID in the plugin JS (CLICK_ID_KEYS, clicutcl-attribution.js:27-31) and yields channel 'Reddit Ads', but it is NOT in the documented portable contract nor in the engine's CLICK_ID_KEYS.
quirk_decision: DISAGREEMENT: plugin captures rdt_cid; engine ignores it (falls to referrer/no_signal). Contract-vs-accident: plugin events.js outbound allowlist (line 1879-1884) EXCLUDES rdt_cid, suggesting accidental inclusion in storage.
